description: v105: Fixes configparser failure when setting Godot renderer. Also persists the fix list JSON as a text file.

steps.name: Switch Godot renderer without using configparser
steps.issue: Godot's project.godot has top-level 'config_version=5' before any section header, causing configparser to fail with MissingSectionHeaderError.
steps.fix_applied: Use sed or Python string replacement to set rendering/renderer/rendering_method to 'gl_compatibility'.

steps.name: Persist the JSON fix list as a local text file
steps.issue: The JSON fix list was not stored in the repo.
steps.fix_applied: Write the full v105 JSON to parachute-fixlist-v105.json.
